root_cause: The 'C++ unit tests' job attempted to download the 'openvino_package' build artifact via actions/download-artifact; each of the 5 HTTP GET attempts against GitHub's Actions blob storage backend (productionresultssa19.blob.core.windows.net) timed out with 'Request timeout', a known transient GitHub Actions ArtifactService/blob-storage backend issue unrelated to the PR's diff (the PR only edits .github/scripts/workflow_rerun/errors_to_look_for.json). This is the same recurring infrastructure signature already tracked under pattern f976d98a24b8000d ('artifact download failed after 5 retries|Infrastructure'), previously seen on run 34212848766 for PR #37290, and whose rerun_search_string is already approved and live in errors_to_look_for.json on master, so the workflow rerunner should pick this run up automatically on its next sweep.
reproduction_steps: N/A - not reproducible locally; this is a transient GitHub Actions backend (blob storage) timeout during artifact download, not a code or test issue.
recommended_actions: Re-run the failed 'C++ unit tests' job only (requested via remediate_transient_failure); the PR's diff is unrelated to the failure.
No source code change is needed; monitor whether this signature recurs across many PRs, which would indicate a broader GitHub Actions ArtifactService outage worth reporting to GitHub support.
Confirm the already-approved rerun_search_string 'Artifact download failed after 5 retries' (ticket 9999999) continues to auto-remediate this signature via the workflow rerunner.
prevention_strategies: This is an upstream GitHub Actions infrastructure issue (ArtifactService/blob storage backend) and cannot be prevented from the repository side. Continued reliance on the approved workflow-rerunner pattern and automated remediation (rerun failed jobs / re-add to merge queue) is the practical mitigation.
historical_context: Same signature previously recorded once before (run 34212848766, PR #37290, first_seen 2026-09-08). This is the 2nd occurrence in the pattern database. A related but distinct ArtifactService timeout signature ('Request timeout: /twirp/.../ListArtifacts') was investigated separately and is the subject of the currently-open PR #39348 (which this very run is validating in the merge queue).
